name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.109.0 — The theme pick moves to /spec:sketch's new first-run Theme step — the mocks driver's theme state/compose/open/adopt subcommand family lives outside the mocks state machine, candidates are the signed-off gray kit re-rendered per direction at design/theme/<kebab>/kit.html, and the picked direction's kit page becomes the fidelity reference every later sketch surface is built from [no-ac: review's version-bump check is the oracle]. 7.108.0 — genesis BRIEF drops its `design/tokens.css` precondition and its composed-but-unpicked `## Dissents` check — the theme pick moved to /spec:sketch, which runs after genesis, so neither artifact exists when BRIEF runs; the not-yet-approved `next:` line and its doctrine twin stop enumerating the mocks chain, naming APPROVED instead [no-ac: review's version-bump check is the oracle]. 7.107.0 — Second split of tests/mocks/mocks-driver-2.test.js: the look-probe, capture-gate, and kit-gate tests moved verbatim to mocks-driver-4.test.js after the per-file 45 s budget guard tripped under full-suite load (the file summed ~25 s alone); test count unchanged at 1328.
